verdict.rationale: The docs say cfo.ai issues no API keys or access tokens. Every client signs in through OAuth as a person and acts with that person's full identity, so there is no way to mint scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policy is an adjacent control, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
